description: Evidence types. Evidence is a first-class object; the system prefers CLAIM -> EVIDENCE over CLAIM -> TRUST THE AGENT.

types.description: Automated test output or test report.
Visual capture of a UI or result.
Security scan, audit or assessment output.

rules: Evidence must reference the requirement(s) or task(s) it supports.
Evidence must state how it was produced (command, procedure or source).
A claim without evidence is UNVERIFIED and must not be treated as complete.
